messages:
maria: Heads-up: marketing needs a small reproducible bench dataset + methodology for a launch claim. Need by EOD Thursday. Main asks: which payloads, seed, warmup, quantized variants, p95/p99, cold-start vs steady-state.

sam: Got it. Can you list exact metrics you need? p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, mem, costs?

maria: Priority: p95 latency (1k/2k seq), coldstart vs warmed, per-token cost estimate, failure rates. Also need sample payloads for demo and reproducibility steps. Put in runbook.

lee: Quick q: do you want cache-enabled runs? batch sizes? warmup policy? We can supply both cache-on and cache-off.

maria: Yes both. And include seed for deterministic model variants and how to apply quantization flags. Also need statement for methodology: traffic shaping, concurrency, warmup duration.

olivia: Can we include a prompt set of ~50 that mirrors PLG flows? I can supply prompts + expected outputs for basic sanity/eval.

sam: We can do a scheduled rerun. Proposed command:
```
./bench/run.sh --model redwood-7b --seq 2048 --clients 64 --warmup 120 --batch-size 8 --quantize awq --seed 42 --cache on
```
We'll attach logs and raw latency histograms.

todd: If you include CI artifact links that's ideal. Marketing will use histograms in slides.

sam: Note: quantized runs will have some output diffs. We'll include embedding-sim thresholds and a brief note on acceptability. For reproducibility we'll pin model hash: abcdef123456.

maria: Also need a short plain-language blurb about what the numbers mean and limitations (lab vs prod).

deploy-bot: scheduled job 'marketing-bench-173610' created for 2024-11-15 18:00 UTC

lee: I'll draft the runbook and upload to the shared drive. Expect first artifacts in ~36h.

olivia: I'll hand over the prompt set + expected embedding similarity table.

sam: If marketing needs quicker turnaround, we can do a smoke-run today with 10 prompts.

maria: Smoke today would be great. @sam please kick off and post artifacts to #marketing-bench-artifacts and ping when done. :pray:

sam: On it. Kicking off now.
